a_uniform_vacuum.fails_if: the summed density differs from 2[(1-d)^2 + 1 + d^2] beyond round-off, or the uniform biaxial vacuum is not read EXTENSIVE

b_eigenvalue_identity.fails_if: sum_a iota_aa differs from 2 sum_{i<j} (lam_i - lam_j)^2 on a random symmetric field

c_planted_compact_record.fails_if: the reader does not return three unbroken directions and a flat integral on a record that vanishes outside r = 8
c_planted_compact_record.note: the word prints WITHHELD by the closed-form clause (the exterior is not the vacuum), as it must; the count is the control

d_uniform_uniaxial.fails_if: a uniform uniaxial tensor does not read exactly one unbroken direction

fails_if: the reading of M5.37 § 2 (at most one unbroken generator on the census proton-analog) fails if two or more directions read UNBROKEN on the n 48 endpoint in both windows
